mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (in percent) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline (both HOUST and INDPRO down > 1% in the last month) occurs in more than 30% of cases without subsequent negative 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong labor markets support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 200), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as the Fed's tightening response to inflation pressures dampens equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer-driven economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline (both HOUST and RSAFS down > 1% in the last month) occurs in more than 30% of cases without subsequent negative 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong housing activity supports construction and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window, or the correlation between HOUST and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110, it signals a significant contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
